title: Nudges on tickets taken but silent for days
story: Grillo now shows a system notification when it opens, and once a day after that, naming the tickets you took or were sent that have had no answer for 3 days. It adds no screen; the only new controls are the nudgeAfterDays setting and Grillo's own nudgeHeldSince notes in settings.json. Nothing earlier was replaced.

checks.criterion: On open and once a day, one system notification names the member's taken tickets with no answer for N days (default 3, a setting)
checks.steps: Quit Grillo. In the app data folder's settings.json set "nudgeAfterDays": 0.0001 (about 9 seconds). Start Grillo and open a made-up project such as example-org/nudge-demo. Take one ticket, e.g. 'Sample ticket 1', and leave it unanswered. Quit, wait 15 seconds, start Grillo again.
checks.expected: One notification titled 'Tickets waiting for your answer' saying 'No answer for 0.0001 days or more:' and naming '#<n> Sample ticket 1 (example-org/nudge-demo)'.

checks.criterion: A ticket with an answer newer than N days is not named
checks.steps: Continue from the check above. Answer one question of 'Sample ticket 1' in the own-time form. Quit Grillo, then start it again within 5 seconds.
